front.title: Workload Identity Options for Attested TLS in Confidential Computing

abstract.t: This document surveys how remote attestation for confidential computing is deployed by major cloud providers and derives the learnings. Based on these, it presents multiple options for establishing the identity of a confidential workload in attested TLS for further discussion. The list of options is not exhaustive, and additional options are welcome. The purpose of this document is to help the SEAT working group decide on an approach or approaches for the confidential computing use case.
